Reference / runtime/single_byte

runtime/single_byte#

The native layer under encoding/single_byte, http/http1_chunk, http/http1_head: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under encoding/single_byte, http/http1_chunk, http/http1_head: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Portable ASCII and ISO-8859-1 boundary for encoding/single_byte. Backend locale, native code pages and operating-system defaults never participate in these operations.
